in_hebrew.name: עזריהו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עזריהו הוא שם פרטי עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים עזר לי' או 'ה' עזר'. השם מורכב משתי מילים: 'עזר' שפירושו 'עזרה' או 'תמיכה', ו'יהו' שהוא קיצור של 'יהוה', שם אלוהים בעברית. השם עזריהו מופיע מספר פעמים בתנ'ך, ביניהם על אחד הנביאים ועל אחד המלכים.

in_greek.name: Αζαρίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Αζαρίας είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος עזריהו (עזריהו), που σημαίνει 'Θεός βοηθός' (Θεός: Θεός, βοηθός: βοηθός). Το όνομα αυτό απαντάται στην ελληνική Βίβλο, ιδιαίτερα στο βιβλίο του Β΄ Βασιλέων και στα Χρονικά.

in_latin.name: Azarias
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Azarias derivatur ex hebraeo עזריהו (Azariah), quod significat 'Deus adiutor' vel 'Deus auxiliator'. Nomen hoc in Biblia Latina, quae est Vulgata, invenitur, praesertim in libro Regum et Chronicorum, ubi commemorantur prophetae et reges hoc nomine appellati.

in_english.name: Azarias
in_english.meaning: God helps or God is my helper
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azarias originates from the Hebrew name עזריהו (Azariah), meaning 'God helps' or 'God is my helper'. It is derived from two Hebrew words: 'azar' (עזר), meaning 'help' or 'support', and 'Yah' (יה), a shortened form of Yahweh, the name of God. The name appears several times in the Bible, including references to a prophet and a king. In Christian tradition, Azarias symbolizes divine assistance and guidance. The name has been adopted in various forms across cultures, reflecting its biblical and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Azarias holds cultural significance in various forms of traditions and beliefs from Judeo-Christian heritage. Historically, Azarias is recognized in the Bible as a name given to prominent figures who demonstrated exceptional faith and trust in God's guidance and help. For instance, in the book of Daniel, Azarias is one of the three young Hebrews who faithfully resisted the Babylonian king's orders to abandon their Jewish beliefs and practices. This steadfast dedication to their faith, despite facing the possibility of persecution and death, highlights the strength of Azarias and his fellow Hebrews.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Azarias lies in its emphasis on the idea that God is a source of help, assistance, and comfort in times of need. It serves as a reminder that even when facing the most challenging circumstances, one can always rely on God's strength and support. Furthermore, the name carries the implication of a life devoted to faith and trust in God's providence, similar to the biblical figures who bore this name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Azarias symbolizes unwavering faith and courage in the face of adversity, as depicted in the Old Testament story of the three Hebrew youths, Shadrach, Meshach, and Azarias, who refused to bow down to King Nebuchadnezzar's golden image and were miraculously saved from the fiery furnace.

biblical_reference.note: References to Azariah as a high priest and a king in the Old Testament.

historical_references.reference: According to the Book of Daniel in the Old Testament, Azarias is one of the three young Hebrew men, the 'Chananites of the castle', who refuse to defile themselves by eating the king's meat and drinking the king's wine. They are thrown into a furnace but are miraculously saved.
In the 4th century CE, Saint Azarias of Caesarea Maritima in Palestine was a Christian bishop who was martyred during the persecutions of Emperor Julian the Apostate.
